encoding_operations.description: No input change; reference only, not one of the two main proposed complexity categories.
Atomic numeric token v is relabelled to n+1-v. Punctuation, sequence positions, input length and size token remain fixed. The relabeling is conditional on n.

Each canonical cycle (m,a2,...,ak) becomes (m,ak,...,a2). Its minimum m and cycle ordering stay fixed. Delimiters stay fixed; numeric tokens are reversed separately within each cycle after its first token. This is a structured local reordering, not pointwise token relabeling.
Left composition with the value-reversal permutation generally changes cycle membership, lengths and delimiters and requires decomposition/canonicalization. It is not conjugation by value relabeling.
Exchange positions and values, requiring global content-dependent redistribution in one-line serialization.

additional_known_non_equality_relations.proof: Interior extrema are switches between adjacent up/down comparisons. Up-to-down and down-to-up switches alternate, so their counts differ by at most one.
additional_known_non_equality_relations.counterfactual_control_status: Remains an eligible alternative for the specific equality formula valleys(Tp)=peaks(p), because identity does not satisfy that equality universally. It is not a mathematically unrelated control.
